ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider pre-encryption inhibit chain — shadow copy deletion, recovery sabotage, backup service stop
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Conti / Wizard Spider (a.k.a. FIN12, UNC1878, GOLD ULRICK) pre-detonation sequence leaked in the 2022 'Conti playbook' / Jeffer-leaks: vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, bcdedit recovery-disable, wbadmin catalog wipe, and net stop / taskkill against backup/SQL/AV services — executed within minutes of each other from the same host before the encryptor (conti.exe / locker_v3.exe) drops.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.process_name) as binaries dc(Processes.process_name) as binary_count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*resize shadowstorage*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND (Processes.process="*sql*" OR Processes.process="*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*backup*" OR Processes.process="*sophos*" OR Processes.process="*mcafee*" OR Processes.process="*acronis*")) OR (Processes.process_name="taskkill.exe" AND (Processes.process="*sql*" OR Processes.process="*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*backup*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name _time span=15m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstSeen max(lastTime) as lastSeen dc(process_name) as distinct_inhibit_actions values(process_name) as binaries values(commands) as commands by host user | where distinct_inhibit_actions >= 2 | sort - lastSeen
ucs.kql:
// Conti pre-encryption sabotage chain — fires when >=2 distinct inhibit actions occur on the same host inside a 15m window
let Window = 15m;
let Inhibit = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup"))
     or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sql","veeam","backup","sophos","mcafee","acronis","mssql$"))
     or (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sql","veeam","backup","sophos"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend InhibitAction = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe","vss_delete",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe","wmi_shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe","bcdedit_recovery_off",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe","wbadmin_catalog_delete",
    FileName =~ "net.exe","service_stop",
    FileName =~ "taskkill.exe","process_kill","other");
Inhibit
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp),
            DistinctActions=dcount(InhibitAction),
            ActionsSeen=make_set(InhibitAction),
            CommandsSeen=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            ParentProcess=any(InitiatingProcessFileName)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where DistinctActions >= 2     // 2+ distinct inhibit families inside 15m = playbook execution, not maintenance
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Conti pre-encryption sabotage chain on Sentinel — SecurityEvent 4688
let Window = 15m;
let Inhibit = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe" and CommandLine has "stop" and CommandLine has_any ("sql","veeam","backup","sophos","mcafee","acronis"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith "\\taskkill.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("sql","veeam","backup","sophos"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend InhibitAction = case(
    NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe","vss_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe","wmi_shadow_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe","bcdedit_recovery_off",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe","wbadmin_catalog_delete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe","service_stop",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\taskkill.exe","process_kill","other");
Inhibit
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctActions=dcount(InhibitAction),
            ActionsSeen=make_set(InhibitAction),
            CommandsSeen=make_set(CommandLine, 20),
            ParentProcess=any(ParentProcessName)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where DistinctActions >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Conti / Wizard Spider Pre-Encryption Inhibit Chain
id: 1c8d3d77-conti-inhibit-chain
status: experimental
description: Detects the Conti / Wizard Spider (FIN12 / UNC1878) pre-encryption sequence — shadow-copy deletion, bcdedit recovery sabotage, wbadmin catalog wipe, or backup/SQL/AV service stops — as seen in the 2022 Conti playbook leaks.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa21-265a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/01/01
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'resize shadowstorage'
  selection_wmic:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  selection_bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  selection_wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete catalog'
      - 'delete systemstatebackup'
  selection_servicestop:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\taskkill.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'veeam'
      - 'sql'
      - 'backup'
      - 'sophos'
      - 'acronis'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
fields:
  - ComputerName
  - User
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup software maintenance windows
  - Imaging / re-deployment scripts run by infra team
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.g0102
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 -@User:(*$ OR *SYSTEM*) AND ( ( @Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"resize shadowstorage"*) ) OR ( @Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *Shadowcopy*Delete*) ) OR ( @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*) ) OR ( @Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"*) ) OR ( @Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\taskkill.exe OR *\\TaskKill.exe OR *\\TASKKILL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*veeam* OR *Veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *sophos* OR *Sophos* OR *acronis* OR *Acronis* OR *backup* OR *Backup* OR *MSSQL* OR *mssql*) ) )

Affiliates execute this verbatim before launching conti.exe / locker_v3.exe so backups can't be restored and SQL/Veeam files become non-exclusive. Requiring >=2 distinct inhibit families in a 15m window eliminates legitimate IT

ucs.title: [LLM] Conti / Wizard Spider Rclone exfiltration to MEGA / pCloud cloud storage
ucs.description: Hunts Conti's signature double-extortion exfil step: a renamed-or-vanilla Rclone binary launched with embedded MEGA / pCloud / put.io credentials and high-throughput copy flags. Confirmed in the leaked Conti playbook (Aug 2021) and recovered TTPs from UNC1878 / FIN12 IR cases where rclone.exe was dropped to ProgramData or a user temp dir and pointed at mega.nz before the encryptor ran.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process="*rclone*") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*pcloud:*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR Processes.process="*copy*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" OR Processes.process="*--ignore-existing*" OR Processes.process="*--auto-confirm*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Conti / Wizard Spider Rclone exfil — looks for rclone (or renamed rclone) shipping to MEGA / pCloud cloud storage
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
      or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
      or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone"
      or ProcessCommandLine has "rclone")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
      "mega:","pcloud:","putio:","dropbox:","--config"," copy "," sync ",
      "--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--ignore-existing",
      "--auto-confirm","--no-check-certificate","--max-age")
// drop legitimate signed/admin-installed Rclone if your fleet uses it for backups
| extend Suspicious_Path = FolderPath has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\")
| extend Renamed_Binary = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe" and FileName !~ "rclone.exe"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          FileName, FolderPath,
          OriginalFileName = ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName,
          ProductName = ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentBinary = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, Suspicious_Path, Renamed_Binary
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Conti / Wizard Spider Rclone exfil on Sentinel — SecurityEvent 4688 path
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe"
     or CommandLine has "rclone"
| where CommandLine has_any (
      "mega:","pcloud:","putio:","dropbox:","--config"," copy "," sync ",
      "--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--ignore-existing",
      "--auto-confirm","--max-age")
| extend Suspicious_Path = NewProcessName has_any (@"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, Suspicious_Path
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Conti / Wizard Spider Rclone Exfiltration to MEGA
id: 9f4a2e11-conti-rclone-exfil
status: experimental
description: Detects Rclone (vanilla or renamed) used by Conti / Wizard Spider affiliates to exfil staged data to MEGA, pCloud, or similar cloud storage prior to deploying the Conti encryptor. Pattern documented in the leaked Conti playbook (Aug 2021).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa21-265a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/01/01
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_image:
    - Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'rclone.exe'
    - Product|contains: 'rclone'
  selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'pcloud:'
      - 'putio:'
      - '--transfers'
      - '--multi-thread-streams'
      - '--config'
      - '--ignore-existing'
  condition: selection_image and selection_cmdline
falsepositives:
  - Admin-driven backups using Rclone — allowlist by signing cert / install path
level: high
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1048.003
  - attack.g0102
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 -@User:(*$ OR *SYSTEM*) AND ( @Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) OR @OriginalFileName:(rclone.exe OR Rclone.exe OR RCLONE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*rclone* OR *Rclone* OR *RCLONE*) ) AND @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *Mega\:* OR *MEGA\:* OR *pcloud\:* OR *putio\:* OR *dropbox\:* OR *"--transfers"* OR *"--multi-thread-streams"* OR *"--config"* OR *"--ignore-existing"* OR *"--auto-confirm"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| UserName!=/\$$/
| (ImageFileName=/rclone\.exe$/i OR regex("rclone", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| regex("(mega:|pcloud:|putio:|dropbox:|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams|--config|--ignore-existing|--auto-confirm|--max-age)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| SuspiciousPath := if(regex("\\\\(ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|AppData\\\\(Local|Roaming)\\\\Temp|Windows\\\\Temp|PerfLogs)\\\\", field=ImageFileName, flags="i"), "yes", "no")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SuspiciousPath], function=[min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen), count(as=Hits)])
| sort(LastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Rclone-to-MEGA is a Conti / Wizard Spider fingerprint, not generic ransomware behaviour — the August 2021 leaked Conti operator manual explicitly named rclone with MEGA endpoints, and Mandiant / DFIR Report writeups of UNC1878 / FIN12 cases show the exact same flag set (--transfers, --multi-thread-streams, --config to a hardcoded config file). LockBit affiliates use FileZilla / WinSCP / MegaCmd; B
